question: What event at the moment of bodily death marks the final release?
premises: Bodily death occurs at a time
inference: At the fall of the body, O Goddess, when the skull is pierced, that is the moment of release.
uncertainties: The fused form kapālambhidyate is read as kapālam bhidyate.
plain_english: O Goddess, when at the fall of the body the skull is pierced, then that occurs.
